items.summary: H.R. 1266, the Combating Illicit Xylazine Act, adds xylazine to Schedule III of the Controlled Substances Act. Xylazine is a nonopioid sedative and pain reliever approved for animal use. The bill establishes criminal penalties for illicit manufacturing, distribution, and dispensing, provides specific exemptions for legitimate animal and wildlife uses, requires tracking in the DEA drug reporting system, and directs federal agencies to report on illicit use and trafficking.
items.title: Combating Illicit Xylazine Act

items.label: S. 4668
items.summary: The Protect College Sports Act of 2026 establishes federal rules governing name, image, and likeness (NIL) agreements for college student athletes, creates limited antitrust exemptions for sports broadcasting rights, and sets standards for student health, safety, transfers, and scholarship protections. It also establishes a competitive grant program to improve broadband, technology, and sports media infrastructure at Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs).
items.title: Protect College Sports Act of 2026
